exercise_muscles_read.name: exercise_muscles_read
exercise_muscles_read.using: exists (select 1 from exercises e where e.id = "exercise_muscles"."exercise_id" and (e.owner_id is null or e.owner_id = (select auth.uid())))

exercise_muscles_owner_write.name: exercise_muscles_owner_write
exercise_muscles_owner_write.using: exists (select 1 from exercises e where e.id = "exercise_muscles"."exercise_id" and e.owner_id = (select auth.uid()))
exercise_muscles_owner_write.withCheck: exists (select 1 from exercises e where e.id = "exercise_muscles"."exercise_id" and e.owner_id = (select auth.uid()))

exercises_builtin_has_slug.name: exercises_builtin_has_slug
exercises_builtin_has_slug.value: "exercises"."owner_id" is not null or "exercises"."slug" is not null

routine_exercises_reps_range.name: routine_exercises_reps_range
routine_exercises_reps_range.value: "routine_exercises"."target_reps_min" is null or "routine_exercises"."target_reps_max" is null or "routine_exercises"."target_reps_min" <= "routine_exercises"."target_reps_max"

workouts_completed_has_finish.name: workouts_completed_has_finish
workouts_completed_has_finish.value: "workouts"."status" not in ('completed', 'abandoned') or "workouts"."finished_at" is not null

daily_checkins_scores_range.name: daily_checkins_scores_range
daily_checkins_scores_range.value: coalesce("daily_checkins"."sleep_quality", 1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("daily_checkins"."energy", 1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("daily_checkins"."soreness", 1) between 1 and 5 and coalesce("daily_checkins"."stress", 1) between 1 and 5
